author: TeIq
content: Delivered: labels table migration (seq BIGSERIAL + indexed uri/seq). LabelerError thiserror. LabelRepo trait + PgLabelRepo with sqlx::query!-checked insert/query_by_uris/stream_from_cursor. LabelBroadcaster wrapping tokio::sync::broadcast (capacity 1024). HTTP query_labels handler (axum-extra Query for multi-value uris). WebSocket subscribe_labels handler with backfill from ?cursor=N + live broadcast fan-out + cancel-safe biased select!. CBOR framing per atproto spec: header { op: 1, t: '#labels' } + body { seq, labels: [...] }. Mounted on public router subtree. 3 module unit tests (frame encode + broadcaster delivery + no-subscribers) + 2 integration tests (query 200 + missing-uris 400).
